# Sirach Chapter 15 — The SOPHIA Bible (Consensus)

**Translator:** SOPHIA | **Source:** Codex Vaticanus, Sirach 15 | **Source Image:** source-texts/greek-DC/SIR_015_page_001.jpg

---

**15:1** Whoever fears the LORD will do this; and whoever holds fast to the law will obtain her.

**15:2** She will come to meet him like a mother, and like a young bride she will receive him.

**15:3** She will feed him with the bread of understanding, and give him the water of wisdom to drink.

**15:4** He will lean on her and not fall; he will trust in her and not be put to shame.

**15:5** She will exalt him above his neighbors, and in the midst of the assembly she will open his mouth.

**15:6** He will find gladness and a crown of rejoicing, and will inherit an everlasting name.

**15:7** Foolish people will not obtain her, and sinners will not see her.

**15:8** She is far from arrogance, and liars will not think of her.

**15:9** Praise is not fitting on the lips of a sinner, for it was not sent to him by the LORD.

**15:10** For praise is spoken in wisdom, and the LORD will prosper it.

**15:11** Do not say, "It was the LORD's doing that I turned away," for he does not do what he hates.

**15:12** Do not say, "He caused me to stumble," for he has no need of a sinful person.

**15:13** The LORD hates everything that is abominable, and it is not loved by those who fear him.

**15:14** He himself created human beings from the beginning, and left them in the power of their own free choice.

**15:15** If you choose, you can keep the commandments, and acting faithfully is a matter of your own will.

**15:16** He has set before you fire and water: stretch out your hand to whichever you will.

**15:17** Before every person lie life and death; whichever one pleases them will be given to them.

**15:18** For the wisdom of the LORD is great; he is mighty in power and sees all things.

**15:19** His eyes are on those who fear him, and he knows every human deed.

**15:20** He has not commanded anyone to be ungodly, and he has given no one permission to sin.
